subject: Aged Male Mouse Muscle Fails to Trigger Exercise-Induced Mitochondrial Recycling
script: From Agewell Brief: Aged Male Mouse Muscle Fails to Trigger Exercise-Induced Mitochondrial Recycling. Researchers discover that aged male skeletal muscle fails to execute physical exertion-driven mitochondrial clearance, a breakdown tied directly to altered localized kinase signaling. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
